Now I'm also spotting broken code fences in the candidate — the block-china.sh section appears duplicated, and the whitelist-ingress-from-cloudflare.sh fence seems to close prematurely mid-command.

I'm also checking the table of contents against actual headings — several TOC links point to stale English fragments while the headings themselves got translated, so those anchors won't resolve correctly (like "Production Checklist," "Further Reading," and "Canary Tokens" sections left untranslated in the headings but referenced elsewhere).

I'm noting other translation gaps too, like the "Original credit" attribution line and a note about blocking traffic from China that got dropped entirely, while checking that phrases like "Если вы не хотите собирать образ в 2 утра" read naturally in Russian.

I'm spotting more rough phrasing—"Опустите его" would fit better than the current wording, "loopback-адресу" is more accurate than "адресу обратного хоста," and there are a few awkward constructions and typos scattered through the comments section.
